## RecordCodec class

Schema-aware positional record codec for `@gramstax/lmdb`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class RecordCodec implements ICodec<unknown> 
```
**Implements:** [ICodec](./lmdb.icodec.md)<!-- -->&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Rows encode as positional arrays in column declaration order — field names never reach disk — and decode back to row objects. The codec rides the existing `hookBeforeWrite`<!-- -->/`hookBeforeRead` slot, so no read/write path changes: validation, defaults, enums, indexes, TTL envelopes, and search maintenance all operate on typed rows pre-encoding.

Absent optional columns encode as `undefined` cells and decode back to absent (never present-`undefined`<!-- -->), preserving row shape exactly. Non-array stored values decode through untouched, so rows written before the codec (or raw bytes via `putBinary`<!-- -->) still read.

Implements [ICodec](./lmdb.icodec.md) directly, so a registration installs it with `new RecordCodec(columns)` — the column order doubles as the codec's configuration, which is why this is a class; the dotted-path helpers ride as statics on it (alongside the [LmdbSearch](./lmdb.lmdbsearch.md) statics).
